name: waak-commerce-backend
description: WAAK Luxury Indian Occasionwear Commerce API (Medusa REST Standard)

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/db/migrations', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('src/db/migrations', 'dist/db/migrations', {recursive: true}); if(fs.existsSync('src/db/schema.sql')) fs.copyFileSync('src/db/schema.sql', 'dist/db/schema.sql');"
